title: A plan whose state lies: T1 is done with no recorded gate run

tasks.title: A task somebody marked done by hand

doneWhen.statement: The task's gate ran in this very command and passed — or a manual reason names who checked it and how.
A log entry names this task and was written after it started, saying what landed and what comes next.
Every file this task lists exists on disk.
The docs that describe this change shipped in the same change — name them, or say why none were needed.
Every number in the log entry and in any report carries a locator (file:line, page, verse) or was re-derived — say which.
Anything learned or decided while doing this is recorded with plan learn / plan decide — name the ids, or say nothing was.
